verdict.rationale: Discord publishes an extensive public REST API, OAuth2 authentication, webhooks, and a Gateway WebSocket API with detailed first-party docs, and a live probe confirms the documented REST endpoint responds correctly (gateway URL returned) validating the API is real and reachable. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent third-party corroboration beyond Discord's own docs.
